test.question: Why is error correction necessary in digital communication systems?

options.D: Because it reduces the need for hardware in communication systems

options.B: Parity bits require significantly more data storage
options.C: Parity bits can detect errors but cannot identify or correct which bit is wrong
options.D: Parity bits only work with odd numbers

options.C: It is only useful for two-bit errors
